summary: Verdera Energy Corp., a TSXV/OTCQB-listed ISR uranium developer, disclosed via 6-K that enCore Energy completed a distribution of Verdera shares to enCore holders of record as of September 25, 2026. The September 30, 2026 distribution totaled 35,000,000 Verdera shares: 21,000,000 unrestricted (0.108 per enCore share), plus two tranches of 7,000,000 each restricted until November 20, 2026 and February 20, 2027 (0.036 per enCore share each). enCore retained 29,332 shares from fractional rounding. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch post-spin selling pressure and enCore's residual stake.
